biggest_catch: Only six referral bonuses per member (maximum $600) — lower than most $500-at-$50 programs in count.
catches: Current members may earn up to six (6) referral bonuses, for a maximum of $600.
The referred person must join Addition Financial and open a qualifying account; employee and youth savings accounts are not eligible.
Bonuses are generally paid within 10 days of the new member's account opening.
Offer is subject to change or termination without notice.

c4.evidence: Timing: bonuses are generally paid within 10 days of the new member's account opening.

eligibility: Current Addition Financial Credit Union members age 18 or older; the referred person must be an eligible new member opening a qualifying account.
